meta.title: feat(talis): add configurable workers flag for concurrent operations
meta.body_summary: Add a global --workers flag to all Talis commands that perform concurrent operations, enabling users to configure worker pool sizes for faster instance creation, deployment, downloads, and status checks.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added workers flag globally; maintainers requested per-command flag and documentation improvements; merged after iterative fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3701 changed lines across 65 files, this is a large PR by absolute volume, but much of the churn comes from merge commits bringing in unrelated changes. The core feature is small, concentrated in tools/talis. Merge after iterative review is appropriate.

review_details.concern_detail: rach-id requested removing global workers flag and adding per-command flags for up, down, deploy, download, reset; also removed workers from status command and improved doc warnings.
review_details.performance_claim: Configurable worker pool enables faster concurrent operations (e.g., instance creation, deployment) by using more workers when network/CPU permits.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot initially used a global flag; maintainers required per-command flags to scope concurrency to specific operations. Iterative fixes addressed this design preference.

detection_detail.code_reading: rach-id reviewed the initial commit and inline comments to request removal of global workers, add per-command flags, remove workers from status, and improve rate limit documentation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing measurements; performance claim is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Initial design (global flag) was corrected via multiple commits from Copilot and maintainer; issues were addressed within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added a --workers flag to Talis CLI commands (up, down, deploy, download, reset) to control the size of the goroutine worker pool for concurrent API operations; default 10. Updated README with usage and DigitalOcean rate limit guidance.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn is from unrelated merge commits; core feature changes are concentrated in tools/talis directory.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added global workers flag and updated all commands to use it.
Review: rach-id requested per-command flags removal of global, remove workers from status, documentation improvements.
Copilot and maintainer made changes: removed global, added per-command flags, removed status workers, improved doc warnings.
Additional reviews: rootulp questioned vague rate limit warning; Copilot added specific DigitalOcean rate limit numbers.

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of global workers flag and addition of per-command workers flags.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed global and added per-command flags.

review_signals.summary: Asked to remove workers flag from status command.
Requested specific rate limit info instead of vague warning.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added DigitalOcean rate limit numbers.

review_signals.summary: Asked for specific max request numbers and safe worker limits.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot updated docs with specific guidance.

rach-id reviewed and requested per-command flags and doc changes.
